bio: This hip bar is loud, lively and trendy – and therein lies its charm! The short menu features various cold cut platters, as well as a selection of tasty and carefully thought-out dishes, which are also served as a set menu – a vegetarian version is also available. A few options can also be ordered to share. For advice on what to drink, just ask the laid-back, well-drilled service team. The wine list is moderately priced and includes a decent selection of wines by the glass. Terrace seating is offered in the inner courtyard behind the restaurant and on the pavement in front of the house....
